info.name: Azure Log Analytics Ingestion Query API

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: The ID of the Log Analytics workspace.

params.name: query
params.description: The Analytics query using Kusto Query Language (KQL).

params.name: timespan
params.description: ISO 8601 duration or time interval over which to query data. Applied in addition to any timespan specified in the query expression.

items.docs: Execute a KQL query against a Log Analytics workspace using GET method. The query is passed as a URL-encoded query parameter.
